title: Emergency Nutrition Kids
description: Covers calorie needs by age, breastfeeding and formula in emergencies, and feeding toddlers, school-age kids, and teens, including picky eaters. Includes hydration and dehydration signs, allergies and diabetes, emotional eating, a three-day sample menu, and a kids' nutrition kit.
shortDescription: Calorie needs, infant feeding, and kid-friendly emergency foods by age
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
